response.rationale: R1 is the only candidate and is strongly supported by the raw vignette: episodic hypertension with micturition-related syncope, isolated normetanephrine elevation, and a contrast-enhancing bladder wall mass with lymphadenopathy are all consistent with an extra-adrenal paraganglioma. No competing candidate was supplied for comparison.
